response.sql: SELECT t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY t.ordertypedist;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff is inclusive: patsim = 0.439 counts as high similarity.

alternatives.interpretation: High similarity requires patsim strictly above 0.439.
